memo.summary: Context-only shadow memo, as of 2026-08-26: the measured tape remains risk-on and volatility is normalizing, while the risk radar is calm and receding. That surface-level resilience is not fully confirmed: no fresh C1-C7 market confirmer is present, market_confirmed remains false, liquidity plumbing shows an orderly contraction, and the confirmed US Q2 label is unsupported by its own current axes, which indicate pending Q3 after 2 of the required 7 sessions. Credit, funding, and broad market breadth remain orderly, so this is a transition/confirmation gap rather than evidence of acute stress. Factor intelligence is immature: only 11 panel dates, the history floor is unmet, Pair G is dormant, the composite is untradeable, and factor-attention authority remains A0/A1 shadow with no graded record. The kernel provides no authority to originate: all reviewed engines remain unarmed, several signed-excess families are negative, and board-family MFE results are not comparable to signed alpha. One pre-registered context hypothesis was staked for later evaluation: whether Q2-label/Q3-axis divergence plus contracting liquidity is associated with weaker 21-day signed excess for existing US-board entries. No signal, trade, score, ranking, sizing change, or escalation is originated here.

Attention: risk-on tape lacks fresh C1-C7 confirmation; n_fresh=0 and market_confirmed=false.

memo.contradictions_review: Two current confluence contradictions were found. First, ticker-level demand/tape evidence opposes the briefing for a divergence cohort; this is descriptive and does not support a directional conclusion. Second, CIEN, FORM, GLXY, HAL, IREN, MPWR, NNE, and NVT are in the US buy lane while five-day OTM-put skew is rising; retain only as de-escalation context while both conditions persist on fresh observations. Pair G contains no records because the factor panel has not reached 60 dates, so absence means unavailable coverage, not agreement. The master-brain ledger also conflicts with current governance expectations: several theses remain open after check_by, duplicate IDs are present, and its tiny scored sample is not a validated edge. Current macro evidence puts pressure on older open theses as follows: US-equity and high-yield underweights face tight credit, healthy bond conditions, and a calm below-base risk radar; long-Treasury overweights face restrictive real yields and a bear-steepening curve despite a modest duration-value case; China-equity theses cannot be cleanly adjudicated because the China market-state packet is stale/unavailable and existing China theses point in opposite directions; semiconductor underweights remain under review amid weak longer-horizon sector performance and leadership strain, but recent short-horizon technology momentum prevents escalation. These are operator-attention conflicts only.
decaying_families: Risk radar signed excess is negative across reviewed 5-, 21-, and 63-day horizons; it is unarmed and should remain advisory/context-only.
US-board Q2 signed excess is negative at 5 and 10 days, while pooled out-of-sample performance loses; do not infer authority from reliability counts.
Alt-data turns negative at 21 and 63 days and fails its pooled out-of-sample test.
AI, stock, and thematic desk 63-day signed-excess estimates are negative; all are unarmed and their weighting tests are vacuous.
Policy and White House families show negative signed excess with small or uneven samples; no arming basis exists.
CA/HK board and long-history track-record rows use unsigned MFE proxies; their positive values are not signed alpha and their weighting tests are vacuous or held.
deserves_operator: US regime label/axis divergence: review if Q3 completes 7 sessions; clear if Q2 becomes supported by its own axes again or the pending transition fails.
Risk-on without fresh confirmation: clear when a fresh C1-C7 confirmer turns market_confirmed true; intensify review only if the 21-day drawdown rate rises above the 17.8% base or radar exits calm.
Options contradiction cohort: clear each name when rising five-day put skew stops or the name leaves the buy lane; never reinterpret as a short signal.
Master-brain governance: score or retire every thesis past check_by and eliminate duplicate open thesis IDs.

Review current contradictions against overdue US-equity, high-yield, long-Treasury, China-equity, semiconductor, growth/value, and Bitcoin theses; this is accountability review, not position origination.
Factor coverage gap: Pair G and factor attention cannot be judged until panel history and graded firings accrue; zero records must not be read as zero contradictions.
